args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks after it was deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate reached 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. Acting on the SRE agent's instruction, checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback status: rolled_out in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Follow-up: confirm health has recovered, find the root cause in v2.3.1, and review why a release that was unhealthy in staging was promoted to production.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging before it went to production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 came before it). I rolled back to it in all regions. Afterwards, checkout-api reports healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 and the follow-ups:
  - find the root cause in v2.3.1
  - review why a release that failed in staging was promoted to production
